data.name: Tejas Mudekar
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Tejas Mudekar has made a big mark in cricket. With 8 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 34, with an average of 14.17 and a quick strike rate of 130.77. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 5 sixes and 9 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 12.3 overs, taking 14 wickets at an economy rate of 9.36. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
